author: Peleila
modifications: Original PNG unchanged. Unity TextureImporter slices four sub-sprites; SpriteAtlas packs their pixels with four-pixel padding, no rotation, no scaling.
note: The author page lists multiple license options including CC0. This project selects CC0 and keeps attribution. Animation frame order is not documented by the author.
runtimeNote: Only BirdRest/BirdWing/PipeCap/Ground are packables. Original atlas is outside Resources. Sky/clouds/hills are original UGUI geometry; audio is synthesized locally.
